description: This file defines API routes for managing user sessions within a FastAPI web application, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting sessions, and posting messages. It interacts with a Supabase backend to handle data operations and enforces user authentication and data security policies.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client configured with environment variables for the current session routing.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all sessions belonging to the authenticated user.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new session for the current user.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session by ID along with its messages, ensuring ownership.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Updates metadata (e.g., title) of a session owned by the user.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Deletes a session owned by the user.

methods.name: post_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Posts a user message to a session, ensuring at least one file exists for the session, and returns an assistant reply stub.
